svg.title: National Tomorrow Learning Card application steps: From job-seeker registration to course enrollment
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
National Tomorrow Learning Card application steps: From
job-seeker registration to course enrollment
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-12
Check excluded applicants first
Under the Employment24 guidance, anyone in Korea
can receive the card, but some people are
excluded.
Determine whether job-seeker
registration is required
If you are unemployed, you must first apply for
a job on Employment24.
Apply for issuance and receive the
physical card
You can apply for issuance online through
Employment24 or by visiting the employment
center with jurisdiction over your place of…
Choose a course and receive diagnostic
counseling
You can search for and apply to courses directly
on Employment24.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
